pairs: Hi sunt autem sacerdotes et Levitæ,
Now these are the priests and the Levites who ascended with Zerubbabel,
qui ascenderunt cum Zorobabel filio Salathiel,
These were the leaders of the priests
et fratres eorum in diebus Josue.
super hymnos ipsi et fratres eorum:
they and their brothers were over the hymns,
In diebus autem Joacim erant sacerdotes
And in the days of Joiakim,
the priests and the leaders of the families were:
The Levites, in the days of Eliashib,
scripti principes familiarum, et sacerdotes in regno Darii Persæ.
were written according to the leaders of the families, during the reign of Darius the Persian.
The sons of Levi, according to the leaders of the families,
were written in the book of the words of those days,
even to the days of Johanan,
Now the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah,
and Jeshua, the son of Kadmiel,
et fratres eorum per vices suas,
and their brothers, in their turns,
ut laudarent et confiterentur juxta præceptum David viri Dei,
so that they would praise and confess, according to the precept of David, the man of God.
And they served equally and in order.
custodes portarum et vestibulorum ante portas.
were keepers of the gates and of the vestibules before the gates.
Hi in diebus Joacim filii Josue,
These were in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua,
and in the days of Nehemiah, the governor,
and of Ezra, the priest and scribe.
Now at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem,
requisierunt Levitas de omnibus locis suis ut adducerent eos in Jerusalem,
they sought the Levites from all their places, so that they might bring them to Jerusalem,
et facerent dedicationem et lætitiam in actione gratiarum,
and so that they might keep the dedication, and rejoice with thanksgiving,
Congregati sunt autem filii cantorum de campestribus circa Jerusalem,
Now the sons of the singing men were gathered from the plains surrounding Jerusalem,
and from the villages of Netophati,
and from the house of Gilgal,
et de regionibus Geba et Azmaveth:
and from the regions of Geba and Azmaveth.
quoniam villas ædificaverunt sibi cantores in circuitu Jerusalem.
For the singing men had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.
Et mundati sunt sacerdotes et Levitæ,
And the priests and the Levites were cleansed,
Ascendere autem feci principes Juda super murum,
Then I caused the leaders of Judah to ascend the wall,
et statui duos magnos choros laudantium.
and I appointed two great choirs to give praise.
Et ierunt ad dexteram super murum ad portam sterquilinii.
And they went to the right upon the wall, toward the dung gate.
and one half part of the leadership of Judah,
Et de filiis sacerdotum in tubis,
And some of the sons of the priests went forth with trumpets:
et Hanani, in vasis cantici David viri Dei:
went forth with the canticles of David, the man of God.
et Esdras scriba ante eos in porta fontis.
And Ezra, the scribe, was before them at the fountain gate.
Et contra eos ascenderunt in gradibus civitatis David in ascensu muri super domum David,
And opposite them, they ascended by the steps of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall above the house of David,
et usque ad portam aquarum ad orientem.
and as far as the water gate to the east.
Et chorus secundus gratias referentium ibat ex adverso,
And the second choir of those who gave thanks went forth on the opposite side,
et media pars populi super murum,
and one half part of the people were upon the wall,
and upon the tower of the furnaces,
as far as the widest wall,
and above the gate of Ephraim,
and as far as the flock gate.
And they stood still at the watch gate.
steteruntque duo chori laudantium in domo Dei,
And the two choirs of those who gave praise stood still at the house of God,
and one half part of the magistrates who were with me.
And the singers were singing clearly,
and Jezrahiah was their foremost leader.
et immolaverunt in die illa victimas magnas,
And on that day, they immolated great sacrifices,
Deus enim lætificaverat eos lætitia magna:
For God had caused them to rejoice with great joy.
sed et uxores eorum et liberi gavisi sunt,
And their wives and children also were glad.
et audita est lætitia Jerusalem procul.
And the rejoicing of Jerusalem was heard from far away.
Recensuerunt quoque in die illa viros super gazophylacia thesauri ad libamina,
On that day also, they enrolled men over the storehouses of the treasury, for the libations,
ut introferrent per eos principes civitatis in decore gratiarum actionis,
so that the leaders of the city might bring these in, by them, with proper thanksgiving,
for the priests and the Levites.
quia lætificatus est Juda in sacerdotibus et Levitis adstantibus.
For Judah was rejoicing in the priests and the Levites who were assisting.
And they kept the vigil of their God,
and the vigil of expiation, with the singing men and the gatekeepers,
in accord with the precept of David,
quia in diebus David et Asaph ab exordio erant principes constituti cantorum in carmine laudantium et confitentium Deo.
For in the days of David and Asaph, from the beginning, there were leaders appointed over the singers, to give praise in verses, and to confess to God.
Et omnis Israël in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Nehemiæ,
And all of Israel, in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah,
dabant partes cantoribus et janitoribus per dies singulos,
gave portions to the singing men and to the gatekeepers, for each day,
and the Levites sanctified the sons of Aaron.
